newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Oakland, Calif.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Oakland, Calif.

text.p: NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL BONDS
City of Oakland
General Obligation Bonds (Series 1997, Measure I)
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the City of Oakland intends to
offer for public sale on
(or on such subsequent Tuesday, Wednesday or Thursday as is
communicated by the Director of Budget and Finance of the
City of Oakland through Munifacts News Service no less than
24 hours in advance), at the hour of 10:00 a.m., California
time, at the offices of Brown & Wood LLP, 555 California
Street, 50th Floor, San Francisco, California 94104,
$45,420,000 principal amount of general obligation bonds of
the City designated City of Oakland General Obligation
Bonds (Series 1997, Measure I) (the
Bonds''). Within
hours of such time, the Director of Budget and Finance of
the City will consider the bids received and, if an
acceptable bid is received, award the sale of the Bonds on
the basis of the true interest cost. In the event that no
bid is awarded by the designated time, proposals will be
received the following Tuesday, Wednesday or Thursday at the
same time and place specified above and each Tuesday,
Wednesday or Thursday thereafter until such time as a bid is
awarded or notice to the contrary is given.
NOTICE IS HEREBY FURTHER GIVEN that the Bonds, dated March
15, 1997, will be offered for public sale subject to the
terms and conditions of the Official Notice of Sale, dated
March 11, 1997. An Official Statement and an Official Notice
of Sale relating to the Bonds will be furnished upon request
mailed to Public Financial Management, Inc., 505 Montgomery
Street, Suite 800, San Francisco, California 94111, (415)
982-5544, the financial advisor to the City for the Bonds.
Dated: March 11, 1997
By:/s/ Dolores E. Blanchard
Director of Budget and Finance
(From The Bond Buyer)
